"""Camera-guided controller for the single billiards episode.
Only rcb_client observations and robot proprioception are used. Kinematics
are the public Panda dimensions, calibrated against reported TCP poses.
"""
import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
from rcb_client import Robot

OUT = Path('/app/output')
LIMITS = np.array([[-2.8973,2.8973],[-1.7628,1.7628],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-3.0718,-.0698],[-2.8973,2.8973],[-.0175,3.7525],[-2.8973,2.8973]])
DOWN = np.array([[0.,-1,0],[-1,0,0],[0,0,-1]])

def fk(q):
    a = [0,0,0,.0825,-.0825,0,.088]
    d = [.333,0,.316,0,.384,0,0]
    alpha = [0,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2,-np.pi/2,np.pi/2,np.pi/2]
    T = np.eye(4)
    T[:3,:3] = Rotation.from_euler('z',np.pi/2).as_matrix()
    T[:3,3] = [0,-.4,.6]
    for ai,di,ali,qi in zip(a,d,alpha,q):
        A = np.eye(4); A[:3,:3] = Rotation.from_euler('x',ali).as_matrix(); A[0,3] = ai
        B = np.eye(4); B[:3,:3] = Rotation.from_euler('z',qi).as_matrix(); B[2,3] = di
        T = T @ A @ B
    F = np.eye(4); F[2,3] = .2; F[:3,:3] = Rotation.from_euler('z',-np.pi/4).as_matrix()
    return T @ F

def ik(p, q0, rot=DOWN):
    def residual(q):
        T = fk(q)
        return np.r_[10*(T[:3,3]-p), Rotation.from_matrix(rot @ T[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec(), .015*(q-q0)]
    result = least_squares(residual, np.clip(q0,LIMITS[:,0]+.001,LIMITS[:,1]-.001),bounds=(LIMITS[:,0]+.001,LIMITS[:,1]-.001),max_nfev=250)
    T=fk(result.x)
    err=np.linalg.norm(T[:3,3]-p)
    ang=np.linalg.norm(Rotation.from_matrix(rot@T[:3,:3].T).as_rotvec())
    if err>.008 or ang>.05:
        raise ValueError(f'IK unreachable: position error {err}, orientation error {ang}')
    return result.x

class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r=Robot(); self.spec=self.r.spec()
        (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(self.spec,indent=2))
        self.res=self.r.get_obs(video='none')
        self.n=len(list(OUT.glob('step_*')))
    @property
    def state(self): return np.array(self.res.meta['proprio']['now'])
    def save(self,label):
        self.n+=1
        self.res.save(OUT/f'step_{self.n:03d}_{label}')
        print(json.dumps({'label':label,'meta':self.res.meta},indent=2),flush=True)
        return self.res
    def observe(self,label='obs',depth=True):
        self.res=self.r.get_obs(include_depth=depth,video='none')
        return self.save(label)
    def move(self,p,seconds=3.,fingers=.04,label='move',rot=DOWN):
        state=self.state; q0=state[:7]; p0=state[16:19]
        r0=Rotation.from_quat(np.r_[state[20:23],state[19]]).as_matrix()
        rv=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@r0.T).as_rotvec()
        rows=[]; q=q0.copy(); n=round(seconds/.1)
        for i in range(1,n+1):
            t=i/n; t=t*t*(3-2*t)
            Ri=Rotation.from_rotvec(rv*t).as_matrix()@r0
            q=ik(p0+t*(np.array(p)-p0),q,rot=Ri)
            rows.append(np.r_[q,[fingers,fingers]])
        return self.submit(rows,label)
    def grip(self,fingers,seconds=1.,label='grip'):
        return self.submit(np.tile(np.r_[self.state[:7],[fingers,fingers]],(round(seconds/.1),1)),label)
    def submit(self,rows,label):
        rows=np.array(rows)
        with (OUT/'actions.jsonl').open('a') as f:
            f.write(json.dumps({'label':label,'dt':.1,'actions':rows.tolist()})+'\n')
        self.res=self.r.submit('joint_position',rows,dt=.1,cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'],video='none',note=label)
        return self.save(label)

if __name__=='__main__':
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument('command',choices=['observe','move','grip']); parser.add_argument('--xyz',nargs=3,type=float); parser.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=3);parser.add_argument('--fingers',type=float,default=.04);parser.add_argument('--label',default='obs')
    args=parser.parse_args(); c=Controller()
    if args.command=='observe': c.observe(args.label)
    elif args.command=='move': c.move(args.xyz,args.seconds,args.fingers,args.label)
    elif args.command=='grip': c.grip(args.fingers,args.seconds,args.label)
